Manuscript Alias: Safe Percentage

Source: R/safe_divide.R
safe_pct_manu.Rd

Returns NA_real_ when the denominator is 0, NA, or NULL. This matches the canonical semantics in manuscript/R/00_manuscript_utils.R. The previous default = 0 caused Step 4/11 to report 0% access when the denominator was missing, creating phantom care-desert artifacts (DEN-032).

Usage

safe_pct_manu(num, den, digits = 1)

Arguments

num

numeric: part (numerator).

den

numeric: whole (denominator); zero/NA/NULL yields NA_real_.

digits

integer: rounding digits for the percentage (default 1).

Value

numeric percentage rounded to digits, or NA_real_ when den is zero/NA/NULL.

See also

safe_percent() (the non-NA-defaulting variant)

Other safe-arithmetic: safe_divide(), safe_divide_manu(), safe_percent(), safe_rate(), safe_ratio()

Examples

safe_pct_manu(45, 90) # 50
#> [1] 50
safe_pct_manu(1, 0) # NA_real_ (not 0 -- avoids phantom 0% artifacts)
#> [1] NA
